deep.reconstruction:
This page holds no derivation. It has two layers.

(1) Right-side-up, top half: several struck-through drafts of the opening sentence of Riemann's 'Theorie der Abel'schen Functionen' (Crelle 54, 1857). The header appears to read '... Ab. Fl.' or 'Abh. Fl.', and is partly struck. The successive attempts are:
(a) 'In der folgenden Abhandlung habe ich die Abel'schen Functionen ausführlich behandelt', struck through.
(b) 'Die folgende Abhandlung enthält eine [kurze Darstellung] meiner Untersuchungen über Abel'sche Functionen, ... Göttingen Mich. 1855-1856', largely struck.
(c) 'In der folgenden Abhandlung habe ich die Abel'schen Functionen nach einer Methode behandelt, deren Principien in meiner Inauguraldissertation aufgestellt [and] ... in drei kleinen Abhandlungen mitgetheilt ...'.
(d) An alternative continuation: '... wie ich sie in meinen ... Göttingen Mich. 1855-1856 gehaltenen Vorlesungen ...'.

This is close to the printed opening. The print says the method's principles were set out in the Inauguraldissertation (1851) and presented in somewhat changed form in the three preceding short papers in the same Crelle volume. The draft also records the Göttingen lectures on Abelian functions of Michaelmas 1855 to 1856. The draft shows Riemann deciding how to cite three sources: the dissertation, the three companion notes ('drei kleinen Abhandlungen'), and the 1855-56 lectures.

(2) Upside down (page turned), lower half: rough pencil notes and sketches on the connectivity of surfaces, i.e. the analysis-situs preliminaries of the same paper. The sketches are:
- an oval containing two small circles (a domain with two holes);
- a circle with an inner circle (an annulus);
- a small closed blob (a simply connected domain);
- a closed curve containing two interlocking loops.
The labels beside them appear to read '3fach', '2fach' and '1fach' (my reading). That would mean triply, doubly and simply connected (Zusammenhangsgrad n+1 for a disc with n holes). The surrounding upside-down prose is only partly legible. It seems to speak of a surface ('Fläche') and how it is 'zusammenhängend' (connected), and probably of cross-cuts (Querschnitte) that reduce connectivity.

Implicit content (mine, standard): a plane domain bounded by an outer curve with n interior holes is (n+1)-fold connected. Each cross-cut joining boundary components lowers the order of connectivity by one, until the domain is simply connected.

results.what: Draft of the introductory sentence of 'Theorie der Abel'schen Functionen' (1857), citing the dissertation, three companion papers and the Göttingen lectures of Michaelmas 1855-56
results.modern_name: Introduction to Riemann's 1857 paper on Abelian functions

results.what: Sketches of plane domains with 0, 1 and 2 holes, labelled (apparently) 1fach, 2fach, 3fach zusammenhängend; notes on connectivity
results.modern_name: Order of connectivity / Betti number of a planar domain; cross-cuts (Querschnitte)

deep.surprise_reason: These are a draft of the published introduction and preliminary sketches for the published analysis-situs section of the 1857 paper. The only small extra is the explicit drafting record of the lecture dates, which are already known from the published text and from Riemann biographies.

checkable.sympy: n = symbols('n', integer=True, nonnegative=True); Eq((n+1) - n, 1)
checkable.asserts: A disc with n holes is (n+1)-fold connected; n cross-cuts reduce it to a simply connected (1-fold) domain.
An annulus (2-fold connected) has Euler characteristic 0 = 2 - (connectivity order), consistent with the 'chi = 2 - N' convention for planar domains with N-fold connectivity.

transcription_corrections: The lower half of the page is written upside down (as the transcription notes). The labels next to the three domain sketches appear to read '3fach', '2fach', '1fach' (multiplicity of connectivity), not illegible.

Line 'Principien [?] in einer Inaug. Diss.' should probably read 'deren Principien in meiner Inauguraldissertation aufgestellt', with 'in drei kleinen Abhandlungen mitgetheilt' as the insertion, matching the printed introduction.
Header at top left is likely 'Abh. Fl.' or similar (partly struck), not certain.
'Mich. 1855-1856' in line 3 is struck through. In the later line '... Göttingen Mich. 1855-1856 gehaltenen Vorlesungen' the date stands, although the whole line also appears crossed out.
